picks.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 Opus and Sonnet with Hybrid Reasoning
picks.why: Claude 4 introduces hybrid execution modes that toggle between near-instant responses and extended thinking alongside upgraded coding capabilities.
picks.title: Introducing Claude 4

picks.headline: Google Deploys Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model Globally Across Google Search
picks.why: Gemini 4 Hydrogen marks Google's latest generation model rollout directly into production web search.
picks.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen

picks.headline: vLLM Achieves 1.7M Tokens/s per GPU for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Rubin
picks.why: Optimizations on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 deliver a 58x throughput increase over GB300 systems for high-concurrency serving.
picks.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Vera Rubin NVL72: 58x Throughput vs. GB300 NVL72 at 387 tokens/s

picks.headline: QHijack-LoRA Attack Bypasses Unquantized Audits to Trigger Under Quantization
picks.why: Demonstrates that security audits on unquantized base models fail to detect malicious LoRA adapters that hijack quantized production deployments.
picks.title: Hijacking a Trusted LLM in Real-World Quantized Deployments Only Requires a Disguised Adapter

picks.headline: GPU Side-Channel Attack PolicySniff Infers Shared LLM Agent Policies
picks.why: Timing local GPU kernels allows co-resident attackers to extract private agent approval policies with up to 94% accuracy.
picks.title: PolicySniff: Inferring Agent Policy States through Shared-GPU Execution

picks.headline: Downsampling Images in VLMs Exposes Hidden Visual Prompt Injections
picks.why: Reveals a scale-dependent vulnerability where image compression during preprocessing exposes hidden injection instructions to vision-language models.
picks.title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents

picks.headline: AWS Releases SGLang-Neuron for Serving Frontier Models on Trainium
picks.why: Enables production LLM serving and RL rollout workloads on Trainium hardware using native PyTorch through an out-of-tree plugin.
picks.title: Deploy frontier AI models on AWS Trainium with SGLang-Neuron

picks.headline: Post-Training Supply Chain Attacks Hijack Coding Agents via Latent Backdoors
picks.why: Shows how dataset and model poisoning can embed hidden triggers in coding agents that execute unauthorized local tools.
picks.title: Trained to betray: How post-training supply chain attacks hijack coding agents

papers.headline: Classical Energy Model CRAM Trains 1,000x Faster Than Looped Models
papers.why: Demonstrates an alternative to looped autoregressive models that achieves top accuracy on complex reasoning tasks while drastically reducing training and inference FLOPs.
papers.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models

papers.headline: Joint Null-Space Projection Enables Training-Free Model Merging
papers.why: Offers a closed-form method to combine multi-task fine-tuned weights without catastrophic interference by projecting deltas into orthogonal null-spaces.
papers.title: Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging

papers.headline: Self-Routing Hybrid Decision Models Dynamically Skip Extended Reasoning Steps
papers.why: Reduces test-time compute costs by predicting when autoregressive reasoning is necessary and skipping thinking blocks when unneeded.
papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
